name: Tilt-Shift Post-Processing
definition: A post-processing effect that keeps a horizontal band of the frame sharp while blurring areas above and below it, increasing color saturation to simulate a miniature model view. It runs on the finished scene before UI elements are drawn to keep text and menus sharp.
summary: Tilt-Shift Post-Processing simulates miniature models by keeping a horizontal band sharp while blurring areas above and below, distinguished by its spatially varying blur strength and increased saturation.
